record_title: Exact gauge family defeats structural identifiability in the time-varying Moose–Wolf models
provenance: Source-specific structural-identifiability analysis of the two non-autonomous Moose–Wolf ODE models in arXiv:2609.20793v1, with exact algebraic gauge families and a compact substitution check.
limitations: The theorem concerns the ODE model with freely time-varying rates. A fixed finite neural-network parameterization may define a smaller function class and requires a separate identifiability analysis. The formulas apply on positive intervals away from x=1 and do not assess forecasting skill or statistical uncertainty.
